method: Run the non-rendering theorem footprint batch auditor once for exactly the two selected roots; compare both declaration hashes and require empty root footprints.
acceptance: Both selected roots retain their preregistered declaration hashes and have empty axiom footprints.
stop_rule: Any import, identity, or footprint failure stops without composition, specialization, output, retry, or ledger authority.
next_on_accept: Freeze V4 with route-specific residual-root assurance in place of whole-stream assurance.
next_on_decline: Descend from the contaminated selected root rather than weakening assurance.
